verdict.rationale: Docs confirm PostHog builds funnels as a core insight type alongside trends, retention, paths, stickiness (posthog-docs-15, posthog-docs-25), which supports the product-manager use case, but the evidence pack never details funnel-specific filtering or breakdown functionality, drop-off visualization, or step conversion analysis. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of funnel filters, breakdown-by-property support, drop-off/step analysis UI, and independent hands-on confirmation that funnels work as described.
